description: Check a Preesy print session's status with its manage_token. Use the manage_token of that session from its create_print_session result earlier in the conversation. The manage_token is a secret and must be kept private. one_time_access: If true, this is a single-use label. As soon as a file or the zip is printed or downloaded, it is removed from the system. one_time_used: True once a file or the zip has been printed or downloaded. The label is then removed from the system. An expired session returns status only.

manage_token.description: Secret returned by create_print_session. Keep it private. A label and PIN do not work here.

name: get_print_session

one_time_access.description: If true, this is a single-use label. As soon as a file or the zip is printed or downloaded, it is removed from the system.

one_time_used.description: True once a file or the zip has been printed or downloaded. The label is then removed from the system.
